### Coverage & Limitations Summary
- Injuries: broad multi-club coverage achieved via FPL's own injury feed cross-checked against RotoWire and press reports.[^1][^2]
- PredictedXI: only a small, well-evidenced sample delivered — the full ~180-220 player table would require individually verifying start probability for each player against very recent (within days) team news, which is beyond what could be confirmed to a FACT/OPINION standard in this pass. Do not treat the omission as "no risk" for unlisted players.
- Rotation: only one specific, sourced pattern met the bar (Man City/Haaland-type Champions League dead-rubber resting); most clubs' rotation chatter was generic and excluded per the brief's own rules.
- SetPieces: full 60-row table delivered with conflicts shown as separate rows and low confidence where order is contested (e.g., Newcastle, Forest, Sunderland, Hull, Everton, Crystal Palace, Ipswich, Tottenham).
- PriceWatch: limited to confirmed same-week movers per official Premier League/FPL price tracker and specialist sites; true "within 0.1m of a change" progress-meter data (e.g., Scout's live predictor) could not be captured as static text, so only just-occurred moves are listed.
